episodeTitle.en: The hierarchy of engagement | Sarah Tavel (Benchmark, Greylock, Pinterest)
episodeTitle.zh: 参与度的层级 | 莎拉·塔维尔（Sarah Tavel，Benchmark、Greylock、Pinterest）

guestBioOfficial.en: Sarah Tavel is a General Partner at Benchmark and sits on the boards of Chainalysis, Hipcamp, Rekki, Cambly, and Medely. She is a founding member of All Raise, the nonprofit organization working to accelerate the success of women in the venture-capital and VC-backed startup ecosystem. Before Benchmark, Sarah was a partner at Greylock Partners. She joined Pinterest in 2012 as their first PM and launched their first search and recommendations features. She also led three acquisitions as she helped the company scale through a period of hypergrowth. In this episode, we discuss: • Sarah’s Hierarchy of Engagement framework for growing a consumer startup
guestBioOfficial.zh: 莎拉·塔维尔是Benchmark的普通合伙人，同时也是Chainalysis、Hipcamp、Rekki、Cambly和Medely董事会成员。她是All Raise的创始成员之一，这是一个致力于推动女性在风险投资和风投支持的初创企业生态系统中取得成功的非营利组织。在加入Benchmark之前，莎拉是Greylock Partners的合伙人。2012年，她加入Pinterest，担任首位产品经理，推出了该平台的首批搜索和推荐功能。她还领导了三次收购，助力公司在高速增长期内实现规模扩张。在本期播客中，我们将讨论：• 莎拉用于发展消费级初创企业的参与度层级框架

title.en: The hierarchy of engagement | Sarah Tavel (Benchmark, Greylock, Pinterest)
title.zh: 参与度的层级 | 莎拉·塔维尔（Sarah Tavel，Benchmark、Greylock、Pinterest）

summary.en: Sarah brings a product-and-growth leader's lens to venture investing, sharing how she evaluates consumer and marketplace startups from first principles. She discusses what makes a compelling founder and product, the metrics and motions that signal durable growth, and lessons from her own operating background at Pinterest. The episode is a rare blend of investor and product-leader thinking applied to building and backing companies.
summary.zh: Sarah 以产品与增长领导者的视角看待风险投资，分享了她如何从源头（first principles）评估消费级与 marketplace 初创公司。她讨论了什么造就一个有吸引力的创始人与产品、哪些指标与打法预示着可持续的增长，以及她在 Pinterest 的运营背景中获得的经验。本期罕见地将投资者与产品领导者的思维融合，应用于打造与押注公司。
